title: VAT check results
description: One row per VAT number: the verdict, the reason, and the company data VIES returned. Charged: VALID, INVALID_VIES (VIES answered no), INVALID_CHECKSUM, NOT_IN_VIES (country outside VIES, national checksum passed). Not charged: INVALID_FORMAT (wrong shape), UNVERIFIED (VIES did not answer), NOT_CHECKED (VIES switched off), UNSUPPORTED_COUNTRY, NOT_ATTEMPTED (the run stopped or ran out of time), ERROR (our own failure on that row).
